abort.already_configured: This key is already set up for this Ablago.

error.cannot_connect: Ablago is not reachable at this address. Check the address and whether Ablago is running.
error.invalid_api_key: Ablago does not accept this key. It may be mistyped, revoked or expired.
error.invalid_url: Enter the address with http:// or https://, for example https://ablago.example.org.
error.not_ablago: No Ablago answers at this address, or it is too old. Use the address you open Ablago with in the browser.
error.redirect: The address redirects elsewhere. Use the address Ablago ends up at, usually with https://.
error.ssl_error: The certificate of Ablago is not trusted (expired, self-signed or for another name). Fix the certificate or turn off the certificate check.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.

user.title: Connect Ablago
user.description: Every person adds their own entry. Create a key of the level "counters only" in Ablago under My account → Security → API keys. Afterwards, rename the device after the person, for example "Ablago · Lena".

data_description.url: The address you open Ablago with in the browser, for example https://ablago.example.org.
data_description.api_key: Key of the level "counters only" from My account → Security → API keys. It can only read the counters.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this on. Turn it off only for a self-signed certificate in your home network.
